From: Samir Patel <samir@shopvector.com>

Subject: Exploring Redwood for catalog embeddings — a few quick q's

Hi Marcus,

We signed up for Redwood last week (self-serve) and have been poking around the API. ShopVector is exploring embeddings for product search + personalization across our catalog. Before we book a demo, I wanted to run a few quick questions so we can make the call productive:

- Corpus size: ~8M SKUs (images + short descriptions). Is that in scope for a pilot?
- Throughput: we need to support bursts up to ~80 QPS with P95 latency target <150ms for search queries — can Redwood handle that on hosted?
- Model recommendations: any suggested model family for multi-language short-text + image captions?
- Pilot timeline: we’re aiming to kick off a 6–8 week pilot starting early June. Any gotchas for onboarding?

If helpful I can share sample query distributions and a short doc about our SSO requirements. Can you also share what data we should prepare before the demo?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Search & Personalization
ShopVector
samir@shopvector.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@shopvector.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring Redwood for catalog embeddings — a few quick q's

Hi Samir — great to hear you’re already signed up and experimenting. Super relevant use case. Short answers up front, then a few clarifying questions so the demo can be targeted:

- Corpus of 8M SKUs: absolutely in scope for a pilot. We usually recommend a representative slice (100k–500k) for initial performance profiling, then scale to full catalog for cost/throughput estimates.
- Throughput: hosted can support bursts to 80 QPS; for consistent P95 <150ms at that QPS we typically suggest a Dedicated pool or a hybrid routing policy (hosted + reserved burst) depending on concurrency patterns. We’ll run a throughput test during the pilot.
- Model family: for short multilingual text + caption awareness, our customers tend to start with a medium-sized open encoder we vet (we can bring 2-3 curated options to the demo).
- Pilot timeline: 6–8 weeks is realistic. Main onboarding items are SSO/KMS needs, a sample of your queries and a small evaluation prompt set, and a snapshot of the catalog metadata (ids, text fields, image pointers).

A few clarifying Qs I'd love answers to before the call so we can scope the test plan:
1) Typical query length (tokens) and whether queries include image IDs or full text.
2) Expected daily request volume (avg and peak) and whether traffic is steady or spiky (dayparts).
3) Any strict residency/compliance (EU data residency, SOC2 evidence requests) for the pilot?
4) Who should join the technical demo from your side — product, infra, security?

I attached a short "pilot_requirements_template.xlsx" that lists the items we’ll ask for; if you can fill the highlighted rows that’ll speed the ramp.

Two quick slots I can open for a 30–45m discovery + tailored demo:
- Thu May 24, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Fri May 25, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

You can also pick a time directly on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/marcus/30min

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Hi Marcus — thanks for the quick rundown and the template. I filled the high-level answers below and attached our SSO/Onboarding checklist (shopvector_sso_requirements.pdf).

Answers to your questions:
1) Query length: typically 20–40 tokens; queries reference product IDs sometimes but most are free-text short queries.
2) Daily volume: baseline ~250k requests/day, peaks to ~7M/day during sales events (spiky). Peak concurrency we expect ~60–80 QPS for search; recommendation/embedding lookups are lower (~10–15 QPS).
3) Compliance: pilot can be hosted in US region, but for full rollout we need EU residency. SOC 2 evidence would be nice during procurement.
4) Suggested attendees: me (Search), Alyssa (Infra), and our ML engineer Priya (will join if low-level infra/session-level questions come up).

Either of the slots you proposed works for us; Thu May 24 at 10 AM PT is preferred.

Also attaching a ~2-slide overview of our index shape (will send sample query distributions in a follow-up).

Thanks — look forward to the call.
Samir
Head of Search & Personalization
ShopVector
